payload.title: Move people's conversations onto Chatticus channels
payload.description: Ryan 11-02: conversations between people and bots, forum threads included, use the Chatticus message and channel model and one store. Machine records do not move; they stay on the 10-29 removal plan. Today across 7 sites: 6 Reference threads, 13 Story reporting threads, 98 console threads, 1 forum thread, no story_conversation threads. A person's message reaches the bot only when it addresses the bot; otherwise no agent response. Readers to change: Messages page, Story and Reference detail, home page threads. Waits on Chatticus epic chatticus-4b2417. Done: Gherkin scenarios, existing threads migrated site by site after a dry-run count, p.apyr.us docs task updated.
